description: Which paths each AI crawler fetched and what it got, one row per bot and path, verified hits only. Use status "error" to find where the errors in shruwd_get_crawlers came from. Read contentPage before calling an error a problem: it is false for files and framework data (_payload.json, scripts, images, feeds) and for sign-in and account pages, and a framework data file can 404 to everyone by design. worstStatus tells a missing page (404) from a refusal (403). totalPaths above the rows returned means the list was cut. Per-path detail is kept 90 days.

bot.description: Only this bot: a botId from shruwd_get_crawlers, such as oai_searchbot.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

contentOnly.description: Only pages a person reads (contentPage true).

status.description: Only paths that got this answer, most often first. error = 4xx or 5xx.

name: shruwd_list_crawler_paths
title: List crawler activity per path
